paragraphs.text: Live session cost for DeepSeek Harness: CNY/USD official pricing, peak/off-peak split, subagent roll
-up, and an in-app price table editor.
# dsh-session-cost-live

Show the **live cost of the current session** — in CNY or USD — right next to the
token-usage chip a
t the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness composer.
Token counts are already in the shipped chip; this plugin prices them.
## Features

- **Session total, subagents included.** The chip prices the current Session's
own log plus every de

scendant Session the agent spawned, so a delegation-heavy
conversation does not under-report.
- **Tw

o official price tables, zero config.** CNY (the account-billed list) and
USD (the English pricing p

age) are built in for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro`. The panel can switch display currency;

the choice is
remembered per browser.
- **Peak / off-peak split.** Official peak windows (Beijing 0

9:00–12:00 and
14:00–18:00, Monday–Friday) are billed at the peak rate and everything else at
the of

f-peak rate, tracked separately.
- **Exactly the billing buckets.** Uncached input, cached input, ca

che write and
output are disjoint, so the numbers line up with the provider's invoice.
- **Honest ab

out unknown models.** A model with no configured rate makes the
total `-` and the panel says the rat

e is not configured; it never reuses
another model's price.
- **Editable from the Web UI.** Plugins

→ this bundle → **Configure** edits both
price tables as a table: add a model, override a built-in,

restore defaults.
Only overrides are stored, saving applies live without restarting the plugin.
- **

Offline and read-only.** No network calls, no telemetry; the Host half only
reads session logs.

## Usage

- The composer dock shows the session cost: click it for the total plus the
peak-hours and off-peak

billing lines (uncached input / cached input / output;
zero lines are hidden), and to switch between

CNY and USD.
- A session with no billed usage shows no chip.
- Configure prices at **Plugins → dsh-

session-cost-live → Configure**. Built-in
models are listed and marked; edit a rate in place, add a

model with
`provider/model` or `model` plus its four rates, and save. A built-in row you
override ca
n be reset; custom rows can be deleted.

Pricing currently covers the DeepSeek models. For any other route, add its
entry in the same page, f

or example `moonshotai-cn/kimi-k2.6`; set
**Separate peak / off-peak pricing** off when that provide
r charges a flat rate.

Advanced setups can still write the same values into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## How the cost is computed

- Usage comes from the committed Session log (`assistant/message`, with the
in-flight `assistant/att

empt` sample and the shipped `tokenUsage` retry
replacement rule), attributed to the model route of

the settled message.
- Descendant Sessions are located under `<DSH_HOME>/sessions` and folded with t

he
same logic, cached by log-file version, so closed subagent Sessions are still
counted.
- Money is

applied in the projection's client view from the configured tables,
so a price edit re-prices the s
ession without a state migration.
Sample reconciliation output (real run, one day of logs):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`tools/reconcile-day.mjs` replays every local session log through the plugin's
exact fold and price
table. It reads logs only; it never calls a provider.
## Permissions and privacy

- Reads session logs under `$DSH_HOME/sessions` (read-only) to price descendant
Sessions and to run

the reconciliation tool.
- Registers one Host session-projection unit, one composer-dock entry, and

the
configuration page for this bundle.
- Writes nothing except this plugin's own configuration when

you press Save in
its configuration page.
- No network access at runtime.
## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` (tested on `0.2.2-rc.1`).
- Web profile; platform-indepen

dent (Windows, macOS, Linux).
- Requires the shipped composer (`conversation.composer.dock` slot) an

d the
session-projection registry.
